title.narrative: Advancing Ethical and Inclusive AI for the Southern African Judiciary

description.narrative: This workplan aims to strengthen capacities of judicial institutions, policymakers, and stakeholders in Southern Africa to advance ethical and human rights-based approaches to artificial intelligence, in line with the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. Through regional dialogue and targeted capacity-building initiatives, contextualization of the Guidelines for the Use of AI Systems in Courts and Tribunals and other UNESCO knowledge products. This project will support Judiciary stakeholders in addressing the implications of AI for human rights, rule of law, gender equality, and sustainable development. The project also contributes to regional and international cooperation through synergies with the AI4IA platform and the commemoration of the International Day for Universal Access to Information, promoting dialogue on ethical, inclusive, and gender-responsive AI in the Judiciary.
